svg.title: Proposed AWS Orders API performance architecture
svg.desc: Proposed Cognito and WAF protected API with API Gateway caching. Both order methods invoke Lambda inside a private VPC. GET reads through DAX; writes go to DynamoDB through a VPC gateway endpoint.
svg.text: Optional DAX-backed reads and API Gateway response caching
POST PutItem via DynamoDB gateway endpoint
Proposed optimization architecture - not part of the current deployment
DAX and API Gateway caching require account access and add ongoing AWS costs.
AWS architecture icons: official AWS icon set (Q1 2022)
